name: Raspberry Pi Global Shutter Camera
description: 1.6 MP Sony IMX296 global-shutter camera board with a C/CS lens mount and tripod thread, for machine vision on a Raspberry Pi (lens sold separately).

specs.label: Sensor
specs.value: Sony IMX296LQR-C, 1.58 MP colour, 1456 × 1088, 3.45 µm pixels, 6.3 mm diagonal, global shutter

specs.label: Lens mount
specs.value: CS-mount (C-mount with included C-CS adapter); back focus adjustable 12.5–22.4 mm

specs.label: Interface
specs.value: MIPI CSI-2 via 150 mm ribbon; external trigger input

specs.label: IR filter
specs.value: Integrated Hoya CM500 IR cut (removable, irreversible)

specs.label: Weight
specs.value: 34 g (41 g with adapter and dust cap)

envelope.axes: x × y = board/lens-mount face, z = depth excl. lens (brief: 38 × 38 × 19.8 mm, 29.5 mm with adapter and dust cap); drawing shows 25.07 mm overall incl. the 39.5 × 39.5 mm rear cover

features.label: PCB mounting holes
features.value: 4× Ø2.5 mm, 4 mm in from each edge of the 38 × 38 mm board (30 × 30 mm pattern)

features.label: Rear cover
features.value: 39.5 × 39.5 mm, corner clearances Ø5.99 on the 30 mm pattern (R4.75 corners); 2× Ø2.5 holes 24.38 mm apart (7.56 mm from the cover edges), at mid-height (19.75 mm)

features.label: Lens mount
features.value: CS mount: bore Ø22.4, Ø30.75 and Ø36 mm focus ring, centered on the board; sensor window 8.5 mm

features.label: Tripod
features.value: 1/4"-20 in the lens-mount tab on the bottom edge (tab 13.97 mm wide); side view offsets 7.62 / 12.04 / 6.49 mm

features.label: Stack-up (side view)
features.value: Focus ring 5.8 mm, 1.2 mm, 5.02 / 10.35 mm to the PCB, PCB 1.4 mm; 10.16 mm FPC connector at the top (0.8 mm offset)

notes: Official mechanical drawing (PDF, downloaded here) is enough to model it. The board and lens mount match the HQ Camera's (38 × 38 mm, Ø2.5 holes on 30 mm), so a model built for one fits the other's mounts. Amazon search only showed third-party IMX296 boards (e.g. B0C3VGMTRH, B093BY2TK2), not the Raspberry Pi part, so a search link is given.
